item.description: There's nothing else going on that day, right?

item.title: Ukraine drone maker launches self-driving wagon capable of lugging 210kg across bumpy terrain — could this be its next secret weapon to turning the tide of war?
item.description: Temerland’s Gnom L2 carries 210 kilograms across rough terrain, using remote control, larger batteries and mixed wheels and tracks.

item.title: Elon Musk Is Expected to Point His Money Machine at Texas
item.description: Sources tell WIRED that Elon Musk is expected to spend up to $200 million in the midterms. It could be a big boost for GOP Senate candidate Ken Paxton, who’s struggled to raise cash.

item.title: Does giving a camera wings dodge the FCC’s drone ban?
item.description: HoverAir drones always have intriguing gimmicks. This one folds flat to fit in your pocket. This one can land on water. Another can charge inside its carrying case. item.title: Waymo’s cheaper, next-gen robotaxi is now open to all riders in these three cities
item.description: The next-generation robotaxi, called the Waymo Ojai, is central to the company's push towards mass scale, and eventually, profitability.

item.title: Alabama town left powerless against massive new Bitcoin mining data center after developer finds loophole in state zoning laws
item.description: An Alabama town and its county both passed moratoriums, but a 50 MW Bitcoin mine is being built anyway because they aren't allowed to zone.

item.title: OpenAI seeks to one-up Anthropic with new customer privacy protections
item.description: A competition is developing between OpenAI and Anthropic over who can provide the best privacy protections for enterprise customer data.

item.title: Flock CEO says drones are 'probably our fastest growing business', but consumer rights groups say they can 'jeopardize privacy' like license plate readers
item.description: Despite a public backlash against the tech, Flock's business is continuing to expand beyond license plate readers.

item.title: Gwyneth Paltrow is rumored to be throwing a party for AI mogul Sam Altman. People don’t love the optics
item.description: ChatGPT could not have hallucinated a stranger pairing. Gwyneth Paltrow has once again found herself at the center of online discourse, but this time she’s being criticized for allegedly throwing a party.

item.title: Cognition CEO denies report that SpaceX tried to acquire the startup
item.description: SpaceX was reportedly in talks to buy AI coding startup Cognition. SpaceX has already acquired Cursor as it races to catch up to rivals like OpenAI and Anthropic in enterprise AI.

item.title: Travis Kalanick kicks off another round of VC bashing: ‘1% are helpful’
item.description: After raising $1.7 billion for his new robotics company Atoms, Travis Kalanick is introspective about the role VCs have played in his career.
